text:
Florida arrives at St. Louis having come back from three goals down to beat Detroit 5-4 on Thursday, and they're 3-2-0 in their last five. They're also without Brad Marchand and Aleksander Barkov. Matthew Tkachuk has taken Marchand's spot beside Sam Reinhart, and Lars Eller is up to 17:14 a night from 12:14. St. Louis beat Utah 1-0 in a shootout, though they were out-chanced in that game and in four of their last five. Dillon Dube is out.

Our numbers see this as close, with FLA at 3.13 expected goals (the quality of chances) and STL at 3.06. Florida creates more and allows fewer chances, and its power play (1.14 expected goals a game) dwarfs St. Louis's 0.54. But the Panthers take 5.5 penalties a game, which keeps handing out power plays. In net, projected starter Joel Hofer is at +9.7 goals saved above expected this season, while Jacob Markstrom (projected) is at +1.2 after finishing at -16.0 last year.

Reinhart is 59% for a point, one shy of 700 career points. As NHL.com put it, "A lot more goals in him." Tkachuk is 69% for a point on a six-game point streak. For St. Louis, Dylan Holloway has no goals in nine games on 3.7 expected goals and looks due. Our under-the-radar pick is Philip Broberg at 50% for a point, above his 42% season pace, with his ice time projected up to 26:33.
